hero.title: RNT College of Agriculture
hero.summary: RNT College of Agriculture is a private agricultural college at Kapasan in Chittorgarh district. It identifies MPUAT as its affiliating university and publishes an eight-semester agriculture degree. Its syllabus includes crop science, rural work experience and agricultural enterprise modules.

overview.heading: An affiliated agriculture college at Kapasan
paragraphs: RNT is a college profile, with a specific undergraduate agricultural focus. Its official homepage identifies affiliation to Maharana Pratap University of Agriculture and Technology, Udaipur. The course page lists B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture for applicants with 10+2 Agriculture or Science and gives the duration as eight semesters.

The published syllabus carries MPUAT’s agriculture-faculty framework and the Fifth Deans’ Committee curriculum. Early study includes soils, horticulture, agronomy, genetics and agricultural economics. Later semesters identify rural agricultural work experience, agro-industrial attachment and skill-development modules. Applicants should ask the college for the current cohort’s detailed timetable and module choices rather than treating every listed option as guaranteed to run.

campus.heading: A curriculum with rural and enterprise work
campus.intro: The syllabus places Rural Agricultural Work Experience and Agro-Industrial Attachment in the seventh semester. Its final-semester list includes practical enterprise modules; the checked farm webpage itself contains no detailed facility inventory.
practical_learning: Seventh-semester RAWE and agro-industrial attachment are in the published syllabus.
The syllabus lists enterprise options including seed production, beekeeping, mushroom cultivation and nursery management.

faqs.question: Is RNT an independent university?
faqs.answer: It presents itself as a college affiliated to MPUAT, Udaipur.

faqs.question: How long is the college’s degree?
faqs.answer: The official course table gives eight semesters for B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture.

faqs.question: Which school streams are listed?
faqs.answer: The table says 10+2 Inter-Agriculture or Science. A current minimum-marks rule was not verified.

faqs.question: Does the curriculum include rural work experience?
faqs.answer: Yes. The published syllabus places RAWE and agro-industrial attachment in semester seven.

faqs.question: What is the checked accreditation term?
faqs.answer: ICAR lists the college’s B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture for 20 June 2024 to 19 June 2029.
